title: School Trips
subtitle: 本課限定語境：school trips = organized visits or journeys made by students with their school for
description: 本課限定語境：school trips = organized visits or journeys made by students with their school for educational, cultural, recreational, or experiential purposes · 「學校旅行；校外學習活動；學校組織的參觀／出遊」

words.meaning: 教育性短途旅行；校外學習活動
words.note: 表示由學校或教育機構安排、具有明確學習目的的校外活動。
words.example: The school organizes educational excursions to museums and historic sites.
words.exampleZh: 學校會組織前往博物館和歷史遺址的教育性校外活動。

exercises.original: The school organizes school trips to museums and historic sites throughout the year.
exercises.zh: 學校全年會組織前往博物館和歷史遺址的校外學習活動。
exercises.upgrade: The school organizes educational excursions to museums and historic sites throughout the year.

options.explanation: museums and historic sites 明確帶有學習與文化目的，而且由學校正式組織，因此 educational excursions 很自然。
也可能成立，但更突出「某一班一起外出」，未必像 educational excursions 那麼強調學習目的。
holiday 主要是休閒假期，不表示由學校安排。
commute 是日常往返學校，不是特別活動。
會把活動偏向娛樂／觀光，弱化教育目的。
私人度假與學校活動完全不同。

exercises.original: Educational school trips are an important part of the history programme.
exercises.zh: 教育性校外活動是歷史課程的重要部分。
exercises.upgrade: Educational excursions are an important part of the history programme.

options.explanation: part of the history programme 明確說明這些 trips 屬課程學習活動。
歷史課程可能有 fieldwork，但不是所有 educational excursion 都是 fieldwork；only 過度縮窄。
只是休息，不是學習行程。
是日常交通，不是特別活動。

exercises.original: The programme includes several school trips designed to support classroom learning.
exercises.zh: 這個課程包括數次旨在支援課堂學習的教育性校外活動。
exercises.upgrade: The programme includes several educational excursions designed to support classroom learning.

options.explanation: designed to support classroom learning 是最關鍵線索，表示活動有正式教育目的。
觀光假期不一定支援課程。
休閒活動不是 classroom-learning extension。

words.meaning: 班級出遊；班級外出活動
words.note: 表示某一班學生一起參加的外出活動。
words.example: The class outing gave students a chance to relax after their exams.
words.exampleZh: 這次班級出遊讓學生在考試後有機會放鬆。

exercises.original: The teacher planned a school trip for the class after the final exams.
exercises.zh: 老師在期末考試後為全班安排了一次班級出遊。
exercises.upgrade: The teacher planned a class outing after the final exams.

options.explanation: 如果活動有明確學習目的可以用，但 after the final exams 更像班級休閒／團體活動。
for the class + post-exam timing 很自然地表示全班一起外出。
會過度強調正式學習／考察目的。
主辦單位和參與者都不同。

exercises.original: Our school trip to the park was mainly for students to relax and spend time together.
exercises.zh: 我們到公園的班級出遊主要是讓學生放鬆和相處。
exercises.upgrade: Our class outing to the park was mainly for students to relax and spend time together.

options.explanation: relax and spend time together 強調社交與班級凝聚，而不是正式學習。
需要較清楚的教育參觀目的。
通常需要課程觀察／實地學習目的。

exercises.original: The class voted on where to go for its end-of-term school trip.
exercises.zh: 全班投票決定期末班級出遊去哪裡。
exercises.upgrade: The class voted on where to go for its end-of-term class outing.

options.explanation: end-of-term + class choosing destination 指向班級集體外出活動，而不一定是課程研究。
需要明確研究／調查任務。
可能是其中一種，但原句沒有教育目的線索。
規模和挑戰程度通常更高。

words.meaning: 實地考察；校外實地學習
words.note: 表示學生離開課室，到真實場所進行觀察、研究或體驗式學習。
words.example: The biology class went on a field trip to the wetlands.
words.exampleZh: 生物科學生到濕地進行實地考察。

exercises.original: The geography class went on a school trip to study coastal erosion.
exercises.zh: 地理班到校外實地考察海岸侵蝕。
exercises.upgrade: The geography class went on a field trip to study coastal erosion.

options.explanation: geography class + study coastal erosion 是典型離開課室進行實地觀察的學習活動。
也可能是全班外出，但沒有 field trip 那麼精確表達學術／實地學習目的。
可能包含導賞，但 field trip 不一定只有 guided tour；only 太窄。
學習目的比社交目的更明確。

exercises.original: Students collected water samples during the school trip.
exercises.zh: 學生在實地考察期間收集水樣本。
exercises.upgrade: Students collected water samples during the field trip.

options.explanation: collected water samples 是實地科研／學習任務，非常符合 field trip。
範圍太廣，不能突出樣本收集這種課程活動。

exercises.original: The science department organizes school trips to the nature reserve each spring.
exercises.zh: 科學科每年春天都會組織到自然保護區的實地考察。
exercises.upgrade: The science department organizes field trips to the nature reserve each spring.

options.explanation: science department + nature reserve 是典型實地觀察與學習環境。
太廣，也不如 field trips 突出課程目的。

words.meaning: 學校出遊；學校組織的外出活動
words.note: 表示由學校安排的集體外出活動，教育、文化或娛樂性質都可以。
words.example: The school outing included a visit to the zoo and a picnic.
words.exampleZh: 學校出遊包括參觀動物園和野餐。

exercises.original: The school trip included a visit to the zoo and a picnic.
exercises.zh: 這次學校出遊包括參觀動物園和野餐。
exercises.upgrade: The school outing included a visit to the zoo and a picnic.

options.explanation: zoo visit + picnic 同時有教育和娛樂成分，school outing 這個廣義詞最自然。
需要更正式的實地研究活動。
可能含學習元素，但整體是外出活動。

exercises.original: Parents volunteered to help supervise students on the school trip.
exercises.zh: 家長自願協助監督學生參加學校出遊。
exercises.upgrade: Parents volunteered to help supervise students on the school outing.

options.explanation: students + parent supervision + school-organized activity 是典型 school outing 語境。
家長不會為普通每日上學通勤這樣陪同監督。

exercises.original: The school cancelled its annual trip because of bad weather.
exercises.zh: 學校因天氣惡劣取消了年度出遊。
exercises.upgrade: The school cancelled its annual school outing because of bad weather.

options.explanation: annual + school + bad-weather cancellation 表示一次學校組織的外出活動。
不受戶外天氣同樣影響，也不是 trip。

words.note: 表示學生到某個特定場所參觀，主要目的是學習。
words.example: The educational visit to the factory helped students understand the production process.
words.exampleZh: 這次工廠教育參觀幫助學生了解生產流程。

exercises.original: The school trip to the factory helped students understand how products are made.
exercises.zh: 這次工廠教育參觀幫助學生了解產品如何製造。
exercises.upgrade: The educational visit to the factory helped students understand how products are made.

options.explanation: factory + learning how products are made 表示到特定地點參觀學習，educational visit 最精確。
也可能是班級外出，但沒有突出參觀學習目的。

exercises.original: Students prepared questions before the school trip to the science museum.
exercises.zh: 學生在前往科學館作教育參觀前先準備問題。
exercises.upgrade: Students prepared questions before the educational visit to the science museum.

options.explanation: prepared questions + science museum 清楚表明參觀是有學習目的的。

exercises.original: The history teacher arranged a school trip to a local heritage centre.
exercises.zh: 歷史老師安排到本地文化遺產中心作教育參觀。
exercises.upgrade: The history teacher arranged an educational visit to a local heritage centre.

options.explanation: history teacher + heritage centre 是典型 curriculum-linked visit。
原句明確由教師安排，不是 independent。

words.note: 表示以學習、研究、專業觀察或文化考察為主要目的的旅行。
words.example: Senior students joined a study trip to learn about sustainable architecture.
words.exampleZh: 高年級學生參加學習考察團，了解可持續建築。

exercises.original: Senior students joined a school trip to learn about sustainable architecture in another city.
exercises.zh: 高年級學生參加到另一城市的學習考察團，了解可持續建築。
exercises.upgrade: Senior students joined a study trip to learn about sustainable architecture in another city.

options.explanation: senior students + specific academic topic + another city 表示較正式、目的明確的學習旅行。
太偏一般班級外出，不足以突出 academic purpose。
另一城市的特別行程不是每日通勤。

exercises.original: The programme includes a three-day school trip focused on environmental policy.
exercises.zh: 課程包括一個為期三天、以環境政策為主題的學習考察。
exercises.upgrade: The programme includes a three-day study trip focused on environmental policy.

options.explanation: three-day + focused on environmental policy 顯示較長、較正式、明確以學習為目的。
也可泛指學校外出，但對三天、專題學習而言 study trip 更精確。

exercises.original: Students wrote reports after returning from the school trip abroad.
exercises.zh: 學生從海外學習考察回來後撰寫報告。
exercises.upgrade: Students wrote reports after returning from the study trip abroad.

options.explanation: wrote reports after returning + abroad 強烈顯示這個 trip 有正式學習／考察目的。
私人休閒旅行通常不要求學生提交報告。
可以是短途休閒活動，對海外＋報告而言不夠精確。
海外不可能是日常通勤。

falseSynonyms.zh: 假期旅行 ≠ 學校旅行 holiday 的主要目的通常是休閒，不表示由學校安排或有教育目的。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A school trip is organized by a school. A holiday is usually private leisure travel.

falseSynonyms.zh: 度假 ≠ 校外學習 和 holiday 類似，主要表示休假或私人旅遊。
日常通勤 ≠ school trip commute 是每天往返學校／工作地點，不是一次特別活動。
遊覽／導賞 ≠ 整個 school trip tour 可以是 school trip 的一部分，例如 museum tour，但不一定代表整個學校出遊。
探險／考察遠征 ≠ 一般 school trip expedition 通常更長、更具挑戰性，可能涉及科研、探險或特殊任務。
野餐 ≠ 整個校外活動 picnic 可以是 school outing 的一部分，但不是所有 school trips 的同義詞。
語氣與目的不同 - excursion = 較正式、常帶教育／文化目的 - outing = 較日常，常帶社交或娛樂色彩
參觀 vs 行程 - visit = 到某地參觀 - trip = 整個外出旅程
falseSynonyms.point: a school trip to the museum an educational visit to the museum
